scripts.bundle: npm run bundle:css && npm run bundle:js
scripts.postcss: npm run compile:scss && postcss Resources/Stylesheets/CSS/style.css --config Resources/postcss.config.js -o Resources/Stylesheets/CSS/style.css
scripts.bundle:css: npm run stylelint && npm run compile:scss && postcss Resources/Stylesheets/CSS/style.css --config Resources/postcss.config.js | cleancss -o Resources/Stylesheets/CSS/style.min.css
scripts.bundle:js: npm run compile:ts && uglifyjs -o Resources/Scripts/JS/app.min.js -c -m -- Resources/Scripts/JS/app.js
scripts.watch: npm run watch:scss && npm run watch:ts && npm run postcss
scripts.watch:scss: npm run bundle:css && watch "npm run bundle:css" Resources/Stylesheets/SCSS
